limits: The local commit revision observes tracked store mutations through the database manager. It does not observe raw database writes or another tab’s manager. Existing persisted authority rechecks and transactional compare-and-update remain required.
Identical puts and empty clears conservatively advance the revision after commit; ordinary reads and aborted writes do not.
Session events and expiry notifications still need a paired revision envelope and the complete lifecycle ordering acceptance matrix.
This evidence does not prove month-later durable presignature reuse, all reconnect/configuration replacement behavior, or complete R170 acceptance.
